🌟 Welcome to Equine Wellness with Dr. Sandra! 🌟

Hi, I’m Dr. Sandra—licensed chiropractor, equine osteopath, and bodywork specialist. This channel is dedicated to helping horse owners like you create deeper connections, improve comfort, and enhance wellness for your equine partners.

Here’s what you’ll find:
🐴 Bodywork Tips – Hands-on techniques to support your horse’s health.
🐴 Wellness Advice – Keep your horse happy, healthy, and thriving.
🐴 Tutorials – Step-by-step guides to improve movement and comfort.

Let’s make your bond with your horse stronger and their life happier.

🔔 Subscribe now to join the Equine Wellness family!

#EquineWellness #HorseHealth #EquineBodywork
